gt_source: Read every service's C# controllers/Program.cs/Startup.cs (Dapr app-ids, pubsub/state/binding/secret-store names), RedDog.UI vue.config.js server-side fetches, the CorporateTransferService function.json bindings, and the in-repo manifests (branch/base kustomization deployments + Dapr components, branch/dependencies, corporate overlay, local components), treating the branch kustomization as the default deployment.

rabbitmq.what: RabbitMQ broker (Flux HelmRelease rabbitmq in namespace rabbitmq) behind Dapr pubsub component reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq; host from Key Vault secret rabbitmq-connectionstring)

redis.what: Redis (redis-cache-master.redis:6379, Flux HelmRelease redis) behind Dapr state components reddog.state.makeline and reddog.state.loyalty (state.redis)

mssql-deployment.what: Microsoft SQL Server 2019 (k8s Deployment/Service mssql-deployment:1433); reached via EF Core with connection string from secret reddog-sql

reddogreceipts.what: Azure Blob Storage account reddogreceipts, container receipts, behind Dapr output binding reddog.binding.receipt (bindings.azure.blobstorage)

reddog-kv-branch.what: Azure Key Vault reddog-kv-branch behind Dapr secret store component reddog.secretstore (secretstores.azure.keyvault)

azure-service-bus.what: Azure Service Bus (corporate deployment: Dapr pubsub reddog.pubsub of type pubsub.azure.servicebus; also the corp-transfer-service output queues)

reddogdemocorp-cosmosdb.what: Azure Cosmos DB reddogdemocorp (db reddog, collection loyalty) behind the corporate Dapr state component reddog.state.loyalty (state.azure.cosmosdb)

reddog-kv-corp.what: Azure Key Vault reddog-kv-corp behind the corporate Dapr secret store reddog.secretstore

edges.mechanism: Dapr service invocation to app-id order-service (const OrderServiceDaprId): GET product, POST order
Dapr service invocation to app-id make-line-service: GET orders/{storeId}, DELETE orders/{storeId}/{orderId} (driven by Dapr cron input binding 'orders', which is a trigger, not a dependency)
Publishes topic 'orders' on Dapr pubsub component reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq, defined in manifests/branch/base/components/reddog.pubsub.yaml)
Subscribes to 'orders' and publishes 'ordercompleted' on reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq)
Reads/writes per-store order queue in Dapr state store reddog.state.makeline (state.redis at redis-cache-master.redis:6379)
Subscribes to topic 'orders' on reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq)
Reads/writes loyalty summaries in Dapr state store reddog.state.loyalty (state.redis at redis-cache-master.redis:6379)
Subscribes to topic 'orders' on reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq)
InvokeBindingAsync 'create' on Dapr output binding reddog.binding.receipt (bindings.azure.blobstorage, account reddogreceipts)
Subscribes to topics 'orders' and 'ordercompleted' on reddog.pubsub (pubsub.rabbitmq)

EF Core UseSqlServer(Configuration['reddog-sql']); connection string loaded from Dapr secret store (env var reddog-sql not set in manifests); in-cluster SQL Server is mssql-deployment (exact host lives in Key Vault, not in repo)
At startup config.AddDaprSecretStore('reddog.secretstore', ['reddog-sql']) reads the SQL connection string from the Key Vault-backed secret store
Job runs EF Core migrations (UseSqlServer) against the accounting database
daprClient.GetSecretAsync('reddog.secretstore','reddog-sql') when env var reddog-sql is unset (unset in manifests)

UI server (vue-cli-service serve devServer 'before' hook, run by 'npm run container') fetches MAKELINE_BASE_URL/orders/{STORE_ID} server-side for /orders/inflight; base URL from secret branch.config makeline_base_url; make-line-service exposed as LoadBalancer :8082 in services-for-ui.yaml

UI server-side fetches ACCOUNTING_BASE_URL /OrderMetrics, /Orders/Minute/..., /Corp/... ; base URL from secret branch.config accounting_base_url; accounting-service exposed as LoadBalancer :8083 in services-for-ui.yaml

Azure Functions RabbitMQTrigger on queues corp-transfer-orders / corp-transfer-ordercompleted (connection rabbitMQConnectionAppSetting); deployment corp-transfer-fx.yaml is not listed in branch/base/kustomization.yaml
Azure Functions serviceBus output binding to queues orders / ordercompleted (connection MyServiceBusConnection)
Corporate deployment only: reddog.pubsub is pubsub.azure.servicebus
Corporate deployment only: reddog.state.loyalty is state.azure.cosmosdb (note: corporate/kustomization.yaml does not list it or loyalty-service.yaml)
Corporate deployment only: reddog.pubsub is pubsub.azure.servicebus
Corporate deployment only: reddog.secretstore points at Key Vault reddog-kv-corp
Corporate deployment only: reddog.secretstore points at Key Vault reddog-kv-corp
